title: ISMIP6
description: ISMIP6 (Ice Sheet Model Intercomparison Project 6) provides coordinated ice sheet model simulations forced by CMIP6 climate projections. The dataset covers Antarctica (south of ~52°S) with a temporal range of 2001–2101, stored as ~10,000 NetCDF files (~1.3 TB total). It supports multi-model comparison of ice sheet responses to standardized climate scenarios for sea-level rise projections.
